title: AccountListResponseData
description: Represents the response data containing the API status and additional data.

message.description: The message associated with the API response.

description.description: A detailed description of the API response.

requestId.description: The unique identifier for the API request.

requestTime.description: The timestamp of the API request in US/Eastern timezone.

data.description: The actual data returned in the response. Can be of any type.

status.description: The HTTP status code of the API response.

accountType.description: The specific type of the account.

routingNumber.description: The routing number associated with the account.

isRealTimeAccount.description: Indicates if the account is a real-time account.

accountList.description: The list of accounts returned by the query.

totalRows.description: The total number of rows available.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages available.

rowsPerPage.description: The number of rows per page.
